title: Fixed Open Ring Cage and Four Leaf Trowel
description: One newly authored complete walk-behind power-trowel-style static exterior. A continuous low circular tubular guard and four full sloping radial cage stays surround four broad separate blunt horizontal leaves on a common central hub and complete short arms. A compact central transmission-case exterior supports a whole raised motor-shaped block and top cover, with a separate dark side cover. A rear fork and transverse fixed pin root one long inclined control shaft ending in a full transverse two-hand grip and small blank control housing. The leaves retain a visible open interval from the guard, and the upper cage remains genuinely open rather than a closed disc skirt. No old compactor engine or floor-buffer mesh is imported. This whole open guard/flat leaves/central power case/long-handle organization is not a floor buffer recoloured or a plate compactor with corners rounded. Three opaque constant PBR roles, one model zero scenes. Flat lower leaves are only this static display datum, not a load or stable-use proof. No concrete, sharp blades, rotating mechanism, fuel or electrical system, compaction, finishing performance, operation instructions or machinery safety claim. Rigging animation interaction not made.
